description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 012 are a small square terracotta jali, shown in the product photo as a fine square-grid wall standing beside a lawn, suited to garden walls, boundaries and screens where you want privacy without blocking the breeze.

## How it looks
The photo shows many small, even square openings set in a tight grid, so the wall reads as a textured clay surface from a distance and only opens up as you come close. Compared with large open-grid jali, the smaller cells hide more of what is behind the wall while still letting light and air through. The warm clay colour tends to sit well against green lawns and planting.

## Where it works
- **Lawn boundary jali** between a garden and a road or a neighbour's plot.
- **Fine grid jali wall** to screen a utility area, generator or water tank.
- **Jali wall for privacy** around a terrace or sitting area that still needs ventilation.

Fired clay is a traditional walling material in Pakistan and generally handles sun and monsoon rain outdoors, which is why small square terracotta jali is often chosen for garden walls.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Design: small square openings in a fine grid, built as a wall beside a lawn (from the product photo)
- Material colour, block size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you order.

Ask your mason to check the wall height and add support columns or reinforcement where needed; a fine grid holds dust, so a soft brush and plain water are usually enough to clean it.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm, or ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your wall length and height for a dated quote. Read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide) or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of small square terracotta jali?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can a jali wall give privacy and still let air through?
faqs.a: Yes. A fine grid hides more than a large open grid while still passing light and breeze, which is why it is often used beside lawns and terraces.

faqs.q: Small square jali or large open-grid jali: which should I choose?
faqs.a: Small squares give more privacy and a finer texture; a large open grid gives more airflow and a bolder, modern look.
